title: The Bird in the Dirt
lines: A girl finds a bird in the dirt.
The bird has a hurt wing.
Her shirt gets mud on it.
First she gets a box and a rag.
Then she turns a lamp on for it.
The bird curls up and naps.
On the third sun up, the wing is fine.
The girl lets it go in the yard.

questions.ask: What was wrong with the bird?
questions.listenFor: It had a hurt wing. 'It was in the dirt' is where it was, not what was wrong.

questions.ask: What did the girl get for the bird?
questions.listenFor: A box, a rag, and a lamp. Three things - let them go back and count.

questions.ask: Why do you think she let the bird go? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. The wing was fine by the third day.
